summary: Declared interval objectives may start a sample at the claim that names its expected members

rules.detail: An interval objective whose `start` and `expect` name the same claim kind is now admitted (it was refused as two roles); every other kind keeps one role.

compatibility.detail: Existing declarations read and evaluate unchanged. A declaration using the shared kind is refused by older builds, so publish it after every member runs this build.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

recovery.detail: Retire the declaration to stop its evaluation.
